name: Martial Arts Wannabe
subtitle: lacks discipline - leaks ice cream
rules: If you control more characters than any opponent, this card cannot be picked.
flavor: Teach say, student do. Well, not always.
notes: Card prints 'If you control more characters...'; catalog says 'While you control...'. Same static condition. Footer also: original Open R&D concept by Bizze & brotherzane.

name: Murderous Kleptomaniac
subtitle: steals anything he can, even life
rules: COVERT -- If this card is put into a discard pile from play, you may pick a character, item, or location. If you do, remove that card from the game. -- KLEPT – [D][D][D][D][D][D][D][D][D][D] -- COST – Pay 4. Pick a character or item. -- EFFECT – Take control of that card.
flavor: Some Clockman criminals are licensed professionals. Others are less... legitimate.
notes: Card prints 'If this card is put into a discard pile from play...'; catalog says 'When this card is put...'. Same trigger. KLEPT threshold shows 10 [D] icons, matches catalog.

name: Numba 1 Stunna!
subtitle: prize fighter. literally.
rules: TACTICAL -- If this card inflicts damage to a character, that character does not restore during its controller's next RESTORE RULE. -- FLIP UP – 3 [D][D]

name: Opportunistic Pirate
subtitle: theft from any direction
rules: TACTICAL -- COST – You may remove up to 4 cards in an opponent's discard pile from the game. If you do, reduce this card's numeric cost by the number of cards removed.
flavor: For any client.
notes: Card prints 'COST –'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST:'. Footer also: original Open R&D concept by kallisti.

name: Parkour Hoodlum
subtitle: felonious freerunner
rules: While this card is in your hand and there is a location in play, this card gains TACTICAL. -- This card ignores all rules text on locations. (This card cannot be picked by locations and any effects from locations do not affect this card.)
flavor: "Obstacles are found everywhere, and in overcoming them we nourish ourselves."
notes: Footer also: original Open R&D concept by GooDMaN88.

name: Sharpey Pointy Lethal Army Tool
subtitle: a multitude of bad choices
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER YOU CONTROL -- The attached character gains 2 strength. -- UNFOLD -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete the attached character. Reveal the top card of your deck. -- EFFECT – If the revealed card has a numeric cost of 5 or higher, all characters your opponents control lose 1 life. If the revealed card has a numeric cost of 0-4, destroy the attached character. If the revealed card is a resource, destroy the attached character and destroy all characters your opponents control.
flavor: You hold it like this... Or maybe like this? Wait!? No coffee machine?
notes: Badges +2 STR / +0 LIFE / +0 SPD. Footer also: original Open R&D concept by Bizze.

name: Sickened Sarcophyle
subtitle: nearly immortal invalid
flavor: While sarcophyles are resilient against most ailments, they are strangely vulnerable to a few, such as anemia.
notes: No rules text on card.

name: Sneaker Attack!
subtitle: a classic
rules: COST – Play this only during a battle. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle party. -- EFFECT – Add the character you depleted to an attacking or blocking party you control. It gains 1 speed this turn. -- FLIP UP – 2 [D][D]
notes: Card prints 'COST – Play this only during a battle'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST: Deploy this only during a battle'. Footer also: original Open R&D concept by Beniek.

name: Sticky Stealy Hand
subtitle: for all your sticky stealy needs
rules: TACTICAL -- ATTACH TO ITEM -- When this card enters play, flip a coin. If you win, take control of the attached item. If you lose, return this card to its owner's hand. -- If this card leaves play, the attached item's owner takes control of the item.
notes: Card prints 'return this card to its owner's hand' / 'If this card leaves play'; catalog says 'put this card into its owner's hand' / 'When this card leaves play'. Same play. Item has no stat badges.

name: Surreptitious Larceny
subtitle: just ignore the menacing robot army
rules: Choose one of the following as this card's rules text: -- OPTION 1 -- COST – Pick a player. This turn, that player may not play cards using FLIP UP. -- EFFECT – Look at the top card of any deck. -- OPTION 2 -- COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, that character gains COVERT. Draw a card. -- OPTION 3 -- COST – Pick a "gear" card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Attach the "gear" card to the character. This turn, the "gear" card loses all abilities.
notes: Card prints 'COST –' for each option; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST:'.

name: Thabbashite Assailant
subtitle: the living gods call for a killing
rules: [V] – This card gains 1 life. -- [V][V] – This card gains 1 strength. -- [V][V][V] – This card gains 1 speed. -- [V][V][V][V] – This card gains 1 life, 1 strength, and 1 speed.

name: Torchlight District
subtitle: wretched hive of scum and villainy
rules: If a character you control with 3 speed or less attacks, restore it at the end of the battle. -- Characters you control can attack only once each turn.
flavor: Butcher in front, don't ask about the back.
notes: Card prints 'If a character you control with 3 speed or less attacks...'; catalog says 'When a character...'. Same trigger.

name: Totally Random Kid
subtitle: unctuous urchin
rules: If this character inflicts battle damage to a faction, put the top X cards of that opponent's deck into their discard pile where X is the amount of damage inflicted by this character. You may pick an item with X or less numeric cost and destroy it.
notes: Card prints 'If this character inflicts battle damage...'; catalog says 'When this character inflicts...'. Same trigger.

name: Clockman Skydocks
subtitle: look to the skies
rules: UNIQUE SKYDOCKS -- BUSINESS DAY -- COST – Pay 1. Deplete this card. Choose a resource icon. -- EFFECT – Reduce the threshold requirement of the next card you play by 1 of the chosen resource icon. -- OVERTIME – [V][V][V][V][V] -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Choose a resource icon. -- EFFECT – Reduce the threshold requirement of the next card you play by up to 6 of the chosen resource icon.
flavor: One of the few places where it's just about 'getting it done'.
notes: Catalog EFFECTs begin 'This turn, reduce the threshold requirement...' but the card has NO 'This turn' duration (reduction applies to the next card played, with no turn limit). Also card says 'Choose a resource icon' / 'next card you play' / 'chosen resource icon' vs catalog 'Name' / 'deploy' / 'named' (wording only).

name: Remains of Foreman Pete, the Clock Man
subtitle: forgotten relic of a buried past
rules: UNIQUE FOREMAN PETE -- CLOCK IN – [V][V][V] -- COST – Discard a staple resource. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Draw a card. -- WORK IT – [V][V] -- COST – Pick a face-down resource you control. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Put that card into your hand. You may play a resource. -- CLOCK OUT – [V] -- COST – Flip this card face-down under its owner's control. -- EFFECT – Detach a resource from your faction.
flavor: Few residents of Clockman have ever seen their city's namesake.
notes: Item has no stat badges.

name: Time to Retire
subtitle: or just get shot
rules: COST – Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – You may put a resource you control into its owner's hand. Flip the character face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 2 [V]
flavor: I like work. It fascinates me. I sit and look at it for hours.
notes: Card prints 'COST –'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST:'. Card hyphenates 'face-down'.

name: 6r4wny 60dy9u4rd5
subtitle: see also: burly, beefy, and bulging
rules: COST – Pick a character you control. -- If the picked character would be dealt damage, deal damage to this card instead. If the picked character would leave play, this character leaves play in that way instead.
flavor: Please allow me to introduce my associates, Max Deltoid and Chunk McSlabmeats.
notes: Card prints 'COST –'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST:'. Footer also: original Open R&D concept by Imnneren & Axelius.

name: B.A.S.E. Jump
subtitle: Geronimo!
rules: COST – Pick a location. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character, where X is the location's structure. Draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 3 [R]
flavor: You do not need a parachute to B.A.S.E. Jump. You only need a parachute to B.A.S.E. Jump twice.
notes: Card prints 'COST –'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST:'.

name: Barracks of Precipitancy
subtitle: less thinking, more killing
rules: GO TIME! -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Shuffle your deck and then reveal the top card. If the revealed card is a character, put that card into play, otherwise put it on the bottom of your deck. The character can attack even if it has not been in play under your control since the start of the turn. If that character leaves play or is in play at the end of the turn, remove it from the game. -- AT ANY COST! -- COST – Pay 2. Inflict 3 damage to this card. -- EFFECT – Restore this card.
notes: Card says 'If that character leaves play or is in play at the end of the turn, remove it from the game.' (trigger-style); catalog says 'If that character would leave play or is in play at the end of the turn, remove it from the game instead.' (replacement effect). Replacement vs trigger could change gameplay (e.g. leaves-play triggers, discard pile), so flagged different. Rest identical.

name: Battle-Ready Back-Breaker
subtitle: a bulging brute
rules: When this card enters play you may pick a character. If you do, deplete that character.
flavor: Oh, snap!

name: Bloating Bask
subtitle: like a bilious balloon
rules: [R][R][R][R][R][R] – This card gains 1 strength, 1 life and 1 speed.

name: Bloody Fisted Fanatic
subtitle: never ask him the time
flavor: It's always punch o'clock.
notes: No rules text on card.

name: Confrontational Conflagration
subtitle: a real barnburner
rules: COST – Play this only during your turn not during a battle. Pick a character you control. Pick a character an opponent controls. You may pick a location. -- EFFECT – If the picked character you control is a "dragon", X is 2 times its strength, otherwise X is its strength. Inflict X damage to each picked card. -- FLIP UP – 1 [R][R][R]
notes: Card prints 'COST – Play this only...'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST: Deploy this only...'.

name: Discordant Cadencer
subtitle: beats to the march of his own drum
rules: AGITATE -- COST – Pay 1. Lose 2 influence. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains "PROVIDES – [R][R][R]". -- [R][R][R][R][R][R] – This card gains 2 strength.
flavor: Can't you hear it? I thought it would stop, but it never does. Never, ever stops. Inside my head... it's everywhere. Listen, listen, listen!

name: Drill Instructor
subtitle: right in the butt
rules: TACTICAL -- COST – Play this only not during a battle. -- When this card enters play, pick another character. At the start of the next turn that character gains 3 strength for that turn.
flavor: You know what? This is weird. Really, really weird. We're seriously creeped out. Like, not even sure why we did this. We're sorry. No, really.
notes: Card prints 'COST – Play this only not during a battle'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST: Deploy this only not during a battle'.

name: Duelist of Surfeit
subtitle: thoroughly excessive
rules: If a card that provides at least [R] enters play under your control, you may put a token on this card. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it.
flavor: Flyswatter of Doom? Check! Hockey Stick of Holes? Check! Midget Glaive? Check! Trident of Spaghetti? Check! Bubble Blower of Gold? Check! Glove of Awesome! Check! Piles of Bodies? Check! Hoop of Stuff? Check! Thing [...] k! Belt of Bullets? Check! Dude with [...] Arrows of Doom?
notes: Card prints 'If a card that provides at least [R] enters play...'; catalog says 'When a card...'. Same trigger. Flavor text overflows the text box and runs under the footer/rarity banner: the last lines are partly hidden ([...] marks hidden words; punctuation after 'Glove of Awesome' is clipped at the top, looks like '!').

name: Fanatical Shriever
subtitle: citrus? I HATE CITRUS!
rules: TACTICAL -- COST – Play this only not during a battle. You may pick an item. -- When this card enters play, if you picked an item as part of its cost, destroy that item. -- [R][R][R][R][R][R] – When this card enters play you may pick a location. If you do, inflict 2 damage to that card.
flavor: Didn't you know dragons are allergic to lemon parties?
notes: Card prints 'COST – Play this only not during a battle'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST: Deploy this only...'.

name: Fistfight
subtitle: round one... fight!
rules: COST – Play this only not during a battle. Pick a character you control. X is that character's strength. Destroy the character. Pick another character. -- EFFECT – Inflict X+1 damage to the character. -- FLIP UP – 3 [R]
flavor: Like a food fight, except the only thing on the menu are knuckle sandwiches.
notes: Card prints 'COST – Play this only not during a battle'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST: Deploy this only...'.

name: Flaming Cube
subtitle: never pick the box!
rules: This card enters play with 3 tokens on it. -- At the start of your turn put a token on this card. -- If there are at least 6 tokens on this card, destroy it and each opponents' faction loses 6 influence. -- If there are no tokens on this card destroy it. -- CONTROL THE FLAME! -- COST – Any player may use this ability. Destroy a character or item you control. -- EFFECT – Add or remove a token from this card.
notes: Card: 'If there are at least 6 tokens on this card, destroy it and each opponents' faction loses 6 influence.' (unconditional 'and'). Catalog: 'When there are at least 6 tokens..., destroy it. If you do, each opponents' faction loses 6 influence.' (influence loss conditional on destruction; 'When' vs 'If'). Also 'When there are no tokens' (catalog) vs 'If there are no tokens' (card). Probably equivalent in practice but the 'If you do' conditionality differs, so flagged different. Footer also: original Open R&D concept by TomekS.

name: Juice Closet
subtitle: not recommended for food storage
rules: At the start of your turn you may pick a character. If you do, that character gains 1 strength this turn.
flavor: To create a turgid, bloodthirsty maniac: just add juice!
notes: Item has no stat badges.

name: Juice Sale!
subtitle: deep discounts, limited time only
rules: COST – Pick an opponent's character with the highest strength. (If there is tie, you decide which character is picked.) -- EFFECT – This turn, the character cannot block. -- FLIP UP – 2 [R]
flavor: The law of supply demands you buy this juice.
notes: Card prints 'COST –'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST:'.

name: Marauding Madster
subtitle: out of mind - out of control
rules: COST – Pick a character you control. -- When this card enters play, destroy the picked character. -- If this character would be put into your discard pile from anywhere, shuffle it into your deck instead.
flavor: I'm out of here!
notes: Card prints 'COST –'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST:'. Footer also: original Open R&D concept by Strmtrpr81.

name: Rudo Mangod, Dragonweight Champion
subtitle: prettiest pugilist in the platoon
rules: UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS -- When this card enters play, deplete all other characters you control. They cannot be restored by your faction's RESTORE RULE. -- This character gains 1 strength for each depleted warlord character you control.
flavor: Just sit back and watch how it's supposed to be done
notes: Flavor text has no closing period on the card. Footer also: original Open R&D concept by Strmtrpr81.

name: Rushing Crushing Blockhead
subtitle: you are the brute squad
rules: If this card inflicts damage to a faction, destroy this card and inflict 2 damage to your faction. -- This character cannot block. -- [R][R][R][R][R][R] – This card loses all other rules text and loses 1 speed.
flavor: Berserkers are not well-known for their creative problem-solving.
notes: Card prints 'If this card inflicts damage to a faction...'; catalog says 'When this card inflicts...'. Same trigger.

name: Shade of the Devoured Emperor
subtitle: back on unfinished business
rules: UNIQUE PADAMOSE -- At the end of an opponent's turn, you may remove this card from the game, then choose a player and search their deck for a UNIQUE JO, UNIQUE EUSTACE, UNIQUE PLUCK, UNIQUE RUDOLPHUS, or UNIQUE IGNATIOUS and reveal it. If you do, put it into play under your control. -- FLIP UP – 2 [V][V][V][V]
notes: Threshold icons are 4 [V] (volition) on a WARLORD card, not [R]. Footer credit: 'Open R&D concept by Megacon 2012 Live Open R&D Panel'.

name: Shriever Breeding Program
subtitle: building a better shriever
rules: Choose one of the following as this card's rules text: -- OPTION 1 -- COST – Play this only during your turn. -- EFFECT – You may search your deck for a "dragon" card and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand. -- OPTION 2 -- COST – Play this only during your turn. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Deplete the character. Draw a card.
flavor: and by "better" we mostly mean "less impossibly vicious and stubborn."
notes: Card prints 'COST – Play this only during your turn'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST: Deploy this only during your turn'.

name: Skullcrush Steamroller
subtitle: production version of the gore engine
rules: This card cannot be restored by your faction's RESTORE RULE. -- This card can attack only once each turn. -- ASSIST -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete a character you control. -- EFFECT – Restore this card.
flavor: If you build it, it will crush!

name: Super Shiny Caltrops of DOOM!
subtitle: watch where you step
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick a character. If you do, inflict 2 damage to the character. -- If this card would be destroyed, you may pay 2 instead. If you do, put it into play as a face-down resource under its owner's control. -- MOVE -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character if you can. (if you can't, this card remains in play) -- FLIP UP – 2 [R]
notes: Same effect; 'instead' sits after 'you may pay 2' on the card but at the end of the 'If you do' sentence in the catalog. Catalog typo 'owners's' (card: 'owner's'). Item has no stat badges.

name: Thabbashite Warmonger
subtitle: the living gods call for blood
rules: [V] – If a character inflicts battle damage to a faction, X is the number of Threshold Icons of the character. Inflict X damage to the faction of that character's controller.
notes: Card prints 'If a character inflicts battle damage...' and 'the faction of that character's controller'; catalog says 'When a character inflicts...' and 'that character's controller's faction'. Same effect.

name: Ursine Assassin
subtitle: bears bred to be brutal
rules: TO BEAR ARMS -- COST – Pay 1. Pick a character. Destroy a restored character you control. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the character. -- JUST UNBEARABLE – [R][R][R][R][R][R] -- COST – Pay 2. Pick a character. Destroy a restored character you control. -- EFFECT – Inflict 5 damage to the character.
flavor: An amazing asset on an expedition, just don't get in its way when it's pissed... or horny.
notes: Footer also: original Open R&D concept by Azai. A tiny extra italic caption under the footer reads 'It's funny because he has horns.' (not included in flavor).

name: Warbeast of Thabbash
subtitle: the living god calls for servitude
rules: This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each [V] you control.

name: Words of Glory
subtitle: virulent outbreak of violence
rules: COST – Play this only during your turn and not during a battle. -- EFFECT – X is the total strength of all characters your opponents control. Inflict X-3 damage to all characters.
flavor: "ahm.. from this day to the... ahm... ending of the world... ahm... or... ahm... tomorrow or something... we shall be remembered or... uh, Anyway... We few, we happy few, we band of brothers... errr... or cousins... or other relatives... Anyway... I am sure they will remember us if you guys die with me today... Are you in?"
notes: Card prints 'COST – Play this only during your turn and not during a battle'; catalog uses newer 'EXTRA COST: Deploy this only...'. Flavor opening has 'ahm..' (two dots) as printed.
